points.description: States that the stimulus for Sam was the mosquito on his arm (feeling or seeing the mosquito land on/touch his arm). Equivalent wording such as 'the mosquito landing on him' or 'the insect biting/touching his arm' earns the mark.

rubric.notes: Full mark for identifying the mosquito on Sam's arm as the stimulus, in any equivalent wording. No partial credit: naming Jasmine's soda, the slapping, or Sam's response instead of the mosquito earns no mark.
